falseFriends.actual: Use 'thực tế' (real/factual), not 'hiện tại' (which means 'current/at present')
falseFriends.performance: Use 'hiệu suất', not 'màn trình diễn' (arts/show) or 'thành tích' (HR achievement). Note: 'hiệu suất' appears in both OEE full term and Performance pillar — context disambiguates.
falseFriends.available: Use 'tính khả dụng' (operational availability) not 'có sẵn' (in stock/ready-made)
falseFriends.quality: Use 'chất lượng' (manufacturing quality), not 'phẩm chất' (personal character/moral quality)
falseFriends.setup: Use 'thời gian chuẩn bị máy' (machine preparation time), not 'cài đặt' or 'thiết lập' (software configuration)
falseFriends.stop: Use 'dừng máy' (machine stop, noun compound), not bare verb 'dừng' (to stop) — bare verbs cannot serve as noun labels
falseFriends.line: Use 'dây chuyền sản xuất' (production line), not 'dòng' (text line) or 'hàng' (queue/row)
falseFriends.yield: Use 'tỷ lệ đạt yêu cầu lần đầu' (first pass yield rate), not 'sản lượng' (output quantity) or 'năng suất' (agricultural yield)
falseFriends.capacity: Use 'công suất' (production capacity), not 'sức chứa' (physical container volume)

grammarNotes.tones: 6 tones are phonemic. Removing diacritics changes meaning: 'ca' (shift) vs 'cà' (eggplant) vs 'cá' (fish). Full Unicode support mandatory.
grammarNotes.isolating: Analytic/isolating — no inflection. All compounds are multi-word: 'thời gian chu kỳ' (cycle time, 4 words). Same form regardless of syntactic position.
grammarNotes.classifiers: Classifiers required between numbers and nouns: '3 chiếc máy' (3 machines), '5 lần dừng máy' (5 stops), '2 ca' (2 shifts).
grammarNotes.headModifierOrder: Modifiers AFTER head noun (opposite of English): 'tốc độ mục tiêu' (speed + target = target speed), 'thời gian theo kế hoạch' (time according-to plan = planned time).
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Decimal: comma (,). Thousands: period (.). '1.000.000,50'. Percentage: '85%' (no space). European-style, opposite of English.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: Not applicable — Vietnamese has no morphological pluralization. Singular and plural forms are identical.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE is standard. Full term: 'Hiệu suất thiết bị tổng thể'. English acronym used universally in dashboards.
industryContext.highExpansion: Vietnamese produces some of the highest expansion ratios: 'downtime' → 'thời gian ngừng hoạt động' (3.38x). Analytic language structure inherently multi-word.
industryContext.dominantSectors: Electronics (Samsung ~20% exports, Intel, Foxconn, LG), automotive (VinFast, Toyota, Honda), textiles, food & beverage
industryContext.samsungInfluence: Samsung's supplier development program (400+ Vietnamese enterprises) drives lean/TPM adoption. TCVN portal hosts TPM guidance.

commonMistakes: Using 'có sẵn' (in stock) instead of 'tính khả dụng' for OEE availability — commercial vs operational availability
Ambiguous 'hiệu suất' for both OEE overall and Performance pillar — pair with 'P' or 'Performance' parenthetical when referring to pillar
Missing or incorrect diacritics — every Vietnamese word requires correct tone marks. LLM translators sometimes drop diacritics.
Using bare verbs as noun labels: 'dừng' (to stop) cannot label a widget — use 'dừng máy' (machine stop)
Inconsistent downtime terms: 'thời gian ngừng hoạt động' (formal) vs 'thời gian dừng máy' (specific) — maintain terms.json convention
Using 'quý vị' where 'bạn' may be more appropriate — 'quý vị' is very formal; Microsoft guide recommends 'bạn' for B2B software
Font rendering issues — requires full Unicode support for all Vietnamese diacritics
notes: OEE is used; formal 'quý vị'. Tonal with Latin script. Highest expansion for compound time terms (up to 3.38x). Full Vietnamese term available for expansion. P95 expansion 2.40x.
